details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:854-883 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: render_linked_run_timeline caps jobs (20) and steps (40) by position before marking [LONG] and choosing the longest step, so the stalled Implement "Pre-push affected-test gate" step can fall past the cutoff and never be selected.
  WHY: The diagnosis gets the log window of an earlier, shorter step instead of the real stall site. Severity labels were MAJOR in all four reviews, so this is mapped to high. Sonnet also notes the 8 KB text truncation can cut the [LONG] lines.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1560-1672 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The wait loop records IMPL_RUN_ID_LATEST, SCOPED_IMPL_RUN_ID and SCOPED_IMPL_ACTIVE_ID via e2e_note_watched_run (line 1644 and lines 1738-1743) but never records IMPL_RUN_ID_WORKING, the in-progress run it polls.
  WHY: When a newer queued run is "latest" while an older run is in progress, the stall error omits the run that is actually executing. Sonnet suggests adding `e2e_note_watched_run "${IMPL_RUN_ID_WORKING:-}" Implement` next to line 1644.
- tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_plan_polling_guard.py:742-818 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The six new watched-run tests are defined after `if __name__ == "__main__": raise SystemExit(main())`, so main() never collects or runs them.
  WHY: CI runs the file as a script (.github/workflows/ci.yml:1784), so regressions in the watched-run URLs pass CI. Severity disagreement: minimax rated it BLOCKER and the others MAJOR; the highest is used.
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh:833-835 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The two Review timeout `::error::` lines at 833 and 835 do not append `$(e2e_watched_run_urls)`, while the Review errors at 319 and 844 do.
  WHY: The issue asks for watched URLs in every stall or timeout error, and an earlier Review run may already be watched. Sonnet notes line 835 has no run id to print. Sonnet and minimax rated it NIT; openai raised it only as part of a MAJOR task gap.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:LINKED_RUN_LOG_BYTES | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: `_positive_or_default` may accept 0, and `--max-bytes 0` would empty the linked log.
  WHY: This is hardening only. The run still succeeds, so it is fail-open and low impact.
- tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_plan_polling_guard.py:449,457 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `IMPL_CREATED_AFTER_INPUT` is set twice in the same dict literal (F601).
  WHY: This is a lint hit with no runtime effect, because the second assignment is dead.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:893-905 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: slice_log_to_window returns the full text when no line falls inside the parsed window.
  WHY: The diagnosis model gets the full log when it expects a windowed slice, which can lead it to misattribute failures.
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh:115-130 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The watched-run helpers are duplicated byte-for-byte between this script and .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml (lines 1502-1517).
  WHY: The two copies can drift apart, and the lint test only checks that the helper strings exist on each side.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Print the watched run URLs "in every stall / timeout `::error::` line" of the phase wait loops (Phase 1 clarify, Phase 2 plan, Phase 3b implement, Phase 4 review).

  confidence=5

Sonnet and minimax rated it NIT (confidence 2) because agents.d/8248-heal-intake-linked-runs.md documents this as a justified narrowing. Gemini and openai rated it MAJOR (confidence 5), so the highest severity is MAJOR.
- requirement: The Phase 4 timeout errors should print watched run URLs, even when an earlier run was observed.
  expected_change_site: scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh:833-835
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The "no review run appeared" timeout errors at scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh:833-835 do not append the watched-run URLs.
- requirement: Include the watched run id IMPL_RUN_ID_WORKING among the run ids the e2e job holds and surfaces in the Phase 3b stall error.
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml lines 1643-1644 and 1735-1739
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The diff adds four e2e_note_watched_run calls (lines 1644, 1722, 1738, 1739) but never one for IMPL_RUN_ID_WORKING.
- requirement: A contract test that the Phase 3b stall `::error::` in test-and-mark-stable.yml includes the watched run URL.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_plan_polling_guard.py, above def main()
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: test_implement_stall_names_the_watched_run and the other new tests sit after `raise SystemExit(main())` (line 750/751), so CI's script-mode run at .github/workflows/ci.yml:1784 never executes them. Severity: Sonnet MAJOR, minimax BLOCKER.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:render_linked_run_timeline (loops over job_list[:LINKED_RUN_MAX_JOBS] and steps[:LINKED_RUN_MAX_STEPS_PER_JOB]) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The caps cut jobs and steps by position before [LONG] marking and longest selection, so the stalled "Pre-push affected-test gate" step can sit past the 40-step cutoff. The 8 KB truncation can also cut the [LONG] lines.
  WHY: The intake then fetches the log window of an earlier, shorter step. The tests use 3-step jobs, so none of them catches this. Fix: compute [LONG] and longest over all steps, then cap only the rendered lines.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1644,1743 (IMPL_RUN_ID_WORKING polled at lines 1663-1672) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The wait loop holds IMPL_RUN_ID_WORKING but never passes it to e2e_note_watched_run.
  WHY: The stall error can list the wrong run when a newer run is latest while an older one is in progress. Fix: add `e2e_note_watched_run "${IMPL_RUN_ID_WORKING:-}" Implement` next to line 1644.
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh:833,835 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The "Review run pin was advanced..." and "No review workflow run ... ever appeared" errors do not append $(e2e_watched_run_urls), unlike lines 319 and 844.
  WHY: An earlier Review run may already be in E2E_WATCHED_RUN_IDS at line 833, and its URL is dropped. Line 835 has no run id to print. Fix: append the helper at line 833.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:LINKED_RUN_LOG_BYTES | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `_positive_or_default` may accept 0, and `--max-bytes 0` would empty the linked log.
  WHY: Fail-open and low impact, because the run still succeeds.
- tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_plan_polling_guard.py:449,457 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: "IMPL_CREATED_AFTER_INPUT": APPROVED_AT is set twice in the _run_phase_step env dict literal (F601).
  WHY: Lint hit only. The second assignment is dead.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: The new tests must guard the contract ("A contract test that the Phase 3b stall `::error::` ... includes the watched run URL").
  Expected change site: tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_plan_polling_guard.py, in the part of the file that main() runs.
  Evidence of absence: The six new tests are defined after `raise SystemExit(main())` (line 750), and ci.yml:1784 runs the file as a script, so they never run in CI.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Print the watched run URLs "in every stall / timeout `::error::` line" of the phase wait loops (Phase 1 clarify, Phase 2 plan, Phase 3b implement, Phase 4 review).
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml, Clarify stall at line 1017 and Plan stalls at lines 1125 and 1316.
  Evidence of absence: Those lines are unchanged. agents.d/8248-heal-intake-linked-runs.md documents that Clarify and Plan hold no run id while polling, so this is a documented narrowing, not an oversight.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 2
- HARDENING: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh, LINKED_RUN_LOG_BYTES assignment. A value of 0 would empty the linked log. Suggested fix: `[ "${LINKED_RUN_LOG_BYTES}" -gt 0 ] || LINKED_RUN_LOG_BYTES=30000` (1 line). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

  PROBLEM: Capping jobs and steps by position causes steps beyond the cap to be missed, so they are never marked [LONG] or chosen as the "longest" step.
  WHY: Real Implement runs often have 55+ non-skipped steps before the stalled gate step, so the diagnosis gets an irrelevant step's log.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1641-1648 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The watcher only records IMPL_RUN_ID_LATEST and ignores IMPL_RUN_ID_WORKING.
  WHY: If a newer queued run exists, the stall/timeout error lacks the URL of the active run being polled.
- tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_plan_polling_guard.py:749+ | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The new test functions are defined after the `if __name__ == "__main__": raise SystemExit(main())` block.
  WHY: When CI runs the file as a script, it finishes without executing the new tests, so regressions pass silently.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:893-905 (slice_log_to_window) | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The function returns the full text when no line falls inside the parsed window.
  WHY: The diagnosis model gets the full log when it expects a windowed slice, which can lead to misattribution.
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh:115-130 and .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1502-1517 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The watched-run helpers are duplicated byte-for-byte in the shell script and the workflow YAML.
  WHY: The two copies can drift apart if requirements change without updating both.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: In every stall / timeout ::error:: line of the phase wait loops (Phase 1 clarify, Phase 2 plan, Phase 3b implement, Phase 4 review), print the watched run URLs.
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml (Clarify and Plan wait steps).
  Evidence of absence: The Clarify and Plan stall/timeout error lines remain unchanged and do not call e2e_watched_run_urls.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
